description: Image field. Holds an image upload. Carries CaptureOnly (like Attachment) — when true the user may only capture from camera, not pick an existing file. Captured live headless via copilot 2026-08-12 (field sweep #46); ids de-identified.
notes: CaptureOnly is a boolean (captured false) — the same per-type key Attachment carries (CLAUDE.md Node-graph invariants).
Image is one of the six event-less types — the builder offers NO Event tab, so it cannot be a computed SOURCE (CLAUDE.md Field events). It can still be a computed target and take validation.
